text: A hard, crumbly, salty Egyptian cheese of the pecorino/manchego family, made from raw milk without starter.

steps.note: Calf or microbial rennet; the source names no standard coagulant.
Glycolysis, lipolysis and proteolysis give an open texture and a sharp, pungent flavour after 3–4 months.
